Here's the handoff, ready to hand off.

```
ON-CALL HANDOFF — Gateway 503s

ROOT CAUSE
Deploy dep-4471 (gateway, author a.novak, "config: connection-per-request
for pool isolation") changed gateway.pool.perRequest from false to true.
This made every request grab its own database connection instead of
sharing from the pool. The pool holds 20 connections. It ran out fast.

IMPACT WINDOW
Started: 2026-03-14 02:14:18 UTC (first 503, ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED,
pool size 20, in_use 20, waiting 13)
Still failing at end of log: 2026-03-14 03:59:27 UTC
530 failed requests logged in that span, all the same cause.
Only the gateway was hit. logs/worker.log covers the same window
with zero errors — job processing was unaffected.

FIX
Roll back dep-4471 (gateway config generation 119), specifically
gateway.pool.perRequest back to false. No other change in that
deploy is implicated.

NOT THE CAUSE
- dep-4472 (billing-svc, invoice pdf fix, 02:41) — after the errors began
- dep-4473 (catalog-svc, cache ttl, 03:20) — after the errors began
- worker.log WARN at 02:36 (slow query, known issue OPS-2210) — unrelated
```
